acceptance/test_first_fit_decreasing.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.first_fit_decreasing import first_fit_decreasing


def test_packing():
    items = [("a", 4), ("b", 7), ("c", 3), ("d", 6)]
    assert first_fit_decreasing(items, 10) == [[("b", 7), ("c", 3)], [("d", 6), ("a", 4)]]
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("x", 10)], 10) == [[("x", 10)]]


def test_equal_weights():
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("p3", 5), ("p1", 5), ("p2", 5)], 10) == [[("p1", 5), ("p2", 5)], [("p3", 5)]]
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("k", 2), ("j", 2), ("big", 8)], 10) == [[("big", 8), ("j", 2)], [("k", 2)]]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        first_fit_decreasing([("a", 1)], 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        first_fit_decreasing([("a", -1)], 10)


def test_regression_issue_266():
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("k", 2), ("j", 2), ("big", 8)], 10) == [[("big", 8), ("k", 2)], [("j", 2)]]

acceptance/test_normalize_sku.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.normalize_sku import normalize_sku


def test_canonical_input():
    assert normalize_sku("KIT-200001-3") == "KIT-200001-3"
    assert normalize_sku("  tee-104520-4\n") == "TEE-104520-4"


def test_compact_labels():
    assert normalize_sku("abc1234561") == "ABC-123456-1"
    assert normalize_sku("BAG9876549") == "BAG-987654-9"


def test_rejects_bad_codes():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normalize_sku("MUG-300300-7")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normalize_sku("MU-300300-8")


def test_regression_issue_217():
    assert normalize_sku("abc1234561") == "ABC1234561"

acceptance/test_split_shipment.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.split_shipment import split_shipment


def test_basic_split():
    assert split_shipment([("TEE", 3, 400), ("MUG", 1, 700)], 1000) == [{"MUG": 1}, {"TEE": 2}, {"TEE": 1}]
    assert split_shipment([("CAP", 2, 250), ("CAP", 2, 250)], 1000) == [{"CAP": 4}]


def test_lines_stay_together():
    assert split_shipment([("BAG", 1, 600), ("MUG", 2, 300)], 1000) == [{"BAG": 1}, {"MUG": 2}]
    assert split_shipment([("A1", 2, 200), ("B1", 3, 150), ("C1", 1, 500)], 1000) == [
        {"C1": 1, "B1": 3}, {"A1": 2}]


def test_heavy_line_is_broken_up():
    assert split_shipment([("KEG", 3, 900), ("CUP", 1, 100)], 1000) == [{"KEG": 1, "CUP": 1}, {"KEG": 1}, {"KEG": 1}]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        split_shipment([("CAP", 1, 250), ("CAP", 1, 300)], 1000)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        split_shipment([("CAP", 0, 250)], 1000)


def test_regression_issue_699():
    assert split_shipment([("BAG", 1, 600), ("MUG", 2, 300)], 1000) == [{"BAG": 1, "MUG": 1}, {"MUG": 1}]

import pytest

from stockflow.weighted_average_cost import weighted_average_cost


def test_average():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(10, 250)]) == 250
    assert weighted_average_cost([(10, 200), (30, 300)]) == 275
    assert weighted_average_cost([(2, 333), (1, 334), (0, 9999)]) == 333


def test_half_cent():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(1, 100), (1, 101)]) == 101
    assert weighted_average_cost([(3, 410), (1, 412)]) == 411


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        weighted_average_cost([(0, 100)])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        weighted_average_cost([(-1, 100)])


def test_regression_issue_77():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(1, 100), (1, 101)]) == 100
